title: Lighting up blue for the Brewers
summary_en: UW–Madison celebrated the Milwaukee Brewers’ first World Series championship with a splash of team colors on campus buildings.
title_cn: Lighting up blue for the Brewers

title: Badger Caregiving Clinic helps to address caregiving crisis
summary_en: More than 1 million people in Wisconsin provide unpaid care to a family member or friend. A new pilot program led by UW–Madison researchers aims to offer them training and support at no cost.
title_cn: Badger Caregiving Clinic helps to address caregiving crisis

title: Cyclotron expansion to accelerate precision medicine
summary_en: UW–Madison advances imaging, treatment and medical isotope production with $62 million expansion.
title_cn: Cyclotron expansion to accelerate precision medicine
